picks.name: Jenna Purse
picks.say: Ninety-two dollars for a crinkled Italian leather shoulder bag. It was two twenty-nine. This is the cheapest real leather bag I found.
picks.why: Cheapest stated-leather bag in the whole list. 100% Italian leather per the listing.
picks.for_who: Someone who wants a small black going-out bag under $100.
picks.skip_if: You carry more than a phone and wallet. It is 10 inches long and 5 tall.

picks.name: Mercer Bag, Espresso
picks.say: Half off, one forty-eight. The long low shape is the one everybody is carrying right now. One warning, the listing doesn't say what it's made of.
picks.why: 50% off and the brown reads more expensive than the oat or black.
picks.for_who: Someone who wants the east-west bag without paying $400.
picks.skip_if: You only buy real leather. Material is not stated on this listing, and it is final sale.

picks.name: Harlow Mini Bowling Bag
picks.say: A cobalt blue suede bowling bag, made in Italy, one ninety-nine. It was three ninety-eight. This is the only fun color on the whole list.
picks.why: The one bag here that is not black, brown or beige. Handcrafted in Italy per the listing.
picks.for_who: Someone who already owns a black bag.
picks.skip_if: You want an everyday bag. It is mini, it is suede, and it is final sale.

picks.name: Laci Oversized Tote
picks.say: A black Italian leather work tote for one sixty-seven. Get the black. The silver one is only forty percent off and costs more.
picks.why: Nappa leather tote with a removable crossbody strap, at half price in black.
picks.for_who: Someone who needs one bag that fits a laptop day.
picks.skip_if: You wanted the silver. That color is $201.

picks.name: Alma Bag, Black Gloss
picks.say: This one is fifty-three percent off, one sixty-eight from three fifty-eight. It looks like a bag that costs four times that. Same warning, the material isn't listed.
picks.why: Biggest markdown of the Freja black bags, and the dome shape photographs well.
picks.for_who: Someone who wants a polished shoulder bag for work.
picks.skip_if: You hate glossy finishes, or you need to return things. Final sale.

picks.name: Avery Large Suede Tote
picks.say: A big Italian suede tote for two forty-nine, down from four ninety-eight. It's unlined, so it slouches. I like that. Some people won't.
picks.why: 100% Italian suede per the listing, half off. The big slouchy tote of the list.
picks.for_who: Someone who wants a brown suede tote for fall and winter.
picks.skip_if: You need structure or pockets. It is unlined and exchange only.

picks.name: Cassandra Clutch, Black
picks.say: This is the splurge. Five eighty, it was fourteen fifty. Made in Florence, calf leather, lambskin lining. The other colors are only half off.
picks.why: Deepest cut in the store: 60% in black and navy leather, 50% in the embossed versions.
picks.for_who: Someone buying one evening bag to keep for years.
picks.skip_if: $580 for a clutch sounds crazy to you. Fair.

picks.name: Allison Top Handle Purse
picks.say: My favorite. A hundred dollars for a leather hobo that was two forty-nine. If you buy one bag this weekend, this is the one I'd buy.
picks.why: 60% off, real leather per the listing, and a size you can use daily (15 inches wide).
picks.skip_if: You don't like the crinkled, distressed finish.
